en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow street lined with a long, two‑storey classical building with many tall windows and a hanging lantern above an entrance. Several people, including women in long skirts, stand and walk along the street. The scene is overlaid with dense handwritten script. Printed captions at the bottom identify the building and send greetings from the city in both Hungarian and German.
